result.reason: The clause adequately adds up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, but it does not itself require return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days or certification of deletion thereafter. References to Sections 11.2 and 11.3—and the margin comment’s description of them—cannot cure the missing operative requirements without their text. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent, but the incomplete data-return and deletion mechanics materially undermine drafting quality.
